:::{.page-shell} ::: {.eyebrow} Project dashboard ::: ::: {.hero-lead} A structured view of portfolio work across marketing analytics, risk, forecasting, and decision support. ::: ::: {.section-copy} Each card links to a dedicated project page with the problem, methods, tools, and key outcomes in a cleaner dashboard-style format. ::: ::: :::{.group-shell}
Marketing and customer analytics

Insights, targeting, experimentation, and product decisions

::: {.project-grid} ::: {.project-card}
Ad measurement
### Quantifying Impact of Contextual TV Advertising AI-driven ad effectiveness framework using household-level data to measure contextual lift and surface segment-level drivers. ::: {.chip-row} AI-driven analysis Tableau Ad lift ::: [Open project](Projects/contextual-tv-ad-measurement/index.qmd){.btn-link} ::: ::: {.project-card}
Forage simulation
### Electronic Arts Product Management Job Simulation Player segmentation and game performance review framed as a product decision-making exercise. ::: {.chip-row} Segmentation Product analytics Forage ::: [Open project](Projects/ea-product-management-simulation/index.qmd){.btn-link} ::: ::: {.project-card}
Retention
### Churn Prediction & Retention Telecom churn modeling with logistic and neural approaches, threshold targeting, and CLV-aware retention logic. ::: {.chip-row} Churn Neural models CLV ::: [Open project](Projects/churn-prediction-retention/index.qmd){.btn-link} ::: ::: {.project-card}
Personalization
### Personalized Campaign Optimization Message-level response modeling to recommend the best email variant for each customer and improve expected profit. ::: {.chip-row} Personalization Optimization Campaign analytics ::: [Open project](Projects/personalized-campaign-optimization/index.qmd){.btn-link} ::: ::: {.project-card}
Offer strategy
### Targeting & Offer Optimization Predictive targeting for B2B software upsell, with model comparison and profit-based threshold selection. ::: {.chip-row} XGBoost Targeting Profit optimization ::: [Open project](Projects/targeting-offer-optimization/index.qmd){.btn-link} ::: ::: {.project-card}
Incremental impact
### Uplift Modelling Incremental-response modeling framed around smarter treatment allocation and more efficient campaign decisions. ::: {.chip-row} Uplift Treatment effect Targeting ::: [Open project](Projects/uplift-modelling/index.qmd){.btn-link} ::: ::: ::: :::{.group-shell}
Risk and finance

Pricing, credit, and portfolio value decisions

::: {.project-grid} ::: {.project-card}
Quant research
### JPMorgan Chase Quantitative Research Virtual Experience Pricing and risk modeling for an energy trading use case, including forecasting, storage valuation, and expected loss estimation. ::: {.chip-row} Time series Credit risk Forage ::: [Open project](Projects/jpmorgan-quant-research-forage/index.qmd){.btn-link} ::: ::: {.project-card}
Risk modeling
### Credit Risk Analytics Delinquency prediction and risk segmentation to support collections prioritization and customer interventions. ::: {.chip-row} Logistic regression Segmentation Default risk ::: [Open project](Projects/credit-risk-analytics/index.qmd){.btn-link} ::: ::: {.project-card}
Product optimization
### Credit Card Product Optimization & CLV-Based Targeting Factorial offer testing and CLV simulation for a fintech campaign targeting roughly 750K customers across 12 variants. ::: {.chip-row} CLV Experimentation Product strategy ::: [Open project](Projects/credit-card-product-optimization-clv-targeting/index.qmd){.btn-link} ::: ::: ::: :::{.group-shell}
Forecasting and data operations

Planning, automation, and scalable analysis

::: {.project-grid} ::: {.project-card}
Forecasting
### Demand Forecasting Analysis ML forecasting for a large retail chain using promotion and seasonality features to improve planning accuracy. ::: {.chip-row} XGBoost Retail demand WAPE ::: [Open project](Projects/demand-forecasting-analysis/index.qmd){.btn-link} ::: ::: {.project-card}
Data pipeline
### ETL Data Pipeline & Reporting Automation Python-SQL ETL pipeline in Snowflake for multi-source retail and weather data, with automation to improve reporting consistency. ::: {.chip-row} ETL Snowflake Automation ::: [Open project](Projects/etl-data-pipeline-reporting-automation/index.qmd){.btn-link} ::: ::: :::
